mapper.update: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS supervisor_conversations (sequence_id BIGINT GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY, tenant_id VARCHAR(128), user_id VARCHAR(128), session_id VARCHAR(200), run_id VARCHAR(64), question CLOB, answer CLOB, created_at BIGINT, PRIMARY KEY(tenant_id,user_id,run_id))
ALTER TABLE supervisor_conversations ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS required_tools CLOB DEFAULT '["legacy-unclassified"]' NOT NULL
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS supervisor_conversation_session ON supervisor_conversations(tenant_id,user_id,session_id,sequence_id)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS supervisor_memories (tenant_id VARCHAR(128), user_id VARCHAR(128), memory_key VARCHAR(100), memory_value VARCHAR(200), version INT, source VARCHAR(100), confirmed_at BIGINT, expires_at BIGINT, deleted BOOLEAN, PRIMARY KEY(tenant_id,user_id,memory_key))
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM supervisor_conversations WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND user_id=#{userId} AND created_at < #{oldest}
mapper.update: UPDATE supervisor_memories SET memory_value=NULL,deleted=TRUE WHERE expires_at <= #{now} AND deleted=FALSE
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM supervisor_conversations WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND user_id=#{userId} AND run_id=#{runId}
SELECT memory_key,memory_value,version,source,expires_at,deleted FROM supervisor_memories WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND user_id=#{userId} AND memory_key=#{memoryKey}
mapper.update: UPDATE supervisor_memories SET deleted=TRUE,memory_value=NULL WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND user_id=#{userId} AND memory_key=#{memoryKey}
